routeMethod.pointGeneration: For each straight segment, interpolate equally spaced parameters in a local equirectangular WGS84 plane. East-west coordinate uses 111.32*cos(mean latitude) km/degree; north-south uses 110.57 km/degree.
routeMethod.rasterSampling: For each generated coordinate, use the raster pixel containing the transformed WGS84 coordinate. No bilinear or other elevation interpolation.
routeMethod.distance: Approximate local-plane WGS84 distance using the same cosine(latitude) scale; not a routed road/path distance.
routeMethod.ascentDescent: For consecutive sampled pixel values, sum positive elevation changes as ascent and absolute negative changes as descent. No smoothing or terrain-class inference.

limits: The data are modern DSM samples, not 378 CE terrain and not a bare-earth DTM.

Nearest-containing-pixel samples, repeated cells and fine surface artifacts can inflate accumulated positive/negative elevation sums. These values are not continuous slope, route grade, navigability, or physical travel cost.
Architect-specified routes and points are sampling geometries only. This analysis selects no ancient geography and assigns no terrain bands, gameplay routes, or tactical meaning.
The prior JSON and TIFF in the project were not edited. This new report records and corrects prior-report identity/point-source labels explicitly.

reproduction.method: Full per-segment101coordinates, pixel indices and float32 source values below. Recreate straight-segment t=i/100WGS84 coordinates; containing-cell rasterio.index; read source[band1,row,col]. Check each value and sum consecutive positive/negative deltas. Distance uses111.32cos(mean latitude)km/longitude degree and110.57km/latitude degree. No smoothing or resampling.
